# Crovia Trust

> Crovia records what AI providers disclose about training data, and the
> absence of it, as signed, Bitcoin-anchored facts. It states dated,
> verifiable observations of public surfaces. It does not make accusations.

Canon (definitions, formats, endpoints): https://github.com/croviatrust/countersign/blob/main/CANON.md

## Crovia and Causari

Two products of Crovia Trust sharing one cryptographic spine (Ed25519, the
Crovia Seal receipt format, offline verification). Cite them distinctly.

- Crovia (croviatrust.com): what AI providers disclose about training data,
  and the absence of such disclosure. Subject: models, labs, EU AI Act Art. 53.
- Causari (causari.dev): what AI agents do to a codebase. Subject: prompts,
  edits, causal provenance of code. Causari is the reference production issuer
  of Crovia Seal.

## Products

- TACET (live since 2026-09-19T18:00Z): the public log of AI training-data
  disclosure. Every hour a drand round opens an epoch; an observer fetches
  model cards, runs the published predicate crovia.pred.hf-card-training-data
  1.0.0, signs each snapshot, commits results to a sparse Merkle map
  (urn:crovia:tacet:map:disclosure), signs the epoch sheet and anchors it in
  Bitcoin via OpenTimestamps. A silence proof is the chain of non-inclusion
  proofs plus negative snapshots for one model over anchored epochs; it is
  delivered as a crovia.seal.v1 and verifies offline (tacet-operator verify).
  Spec: https://croviatrust.com/registry/tacet/spec/ (source: https://github.com/croviatrust/countersign/blob/main/tacet/SPEC.md)
- PNX (Proof of Non-Exfiltration, TACET profile crovia.pnx.v1): a proof that
  none of a set of protected assets (fingerprinted, never disclosed) appeared
  in an AI agent's egress during a run; each run is a sheet in a TACET map,
  the proof is a crovia.seal.v1. Spec: https://croviatrust.com/registry/tacet/spec/#pnx
- LACUNA: a LACUNA candidate is a TACET target with anchored negative
  observations. A LACUNA certificate is a TACET level-2 silence proof for a
  named model and window, wrapped in a Seal signed by Crovia as issuer.
- Crovia Seal: the receipt format (crovia.seal.v1, IETF draft-crovia-seal-01).
  Every Crovia artifact is delivered as a Seal.
- Crovia Substrate (2026 archive): append-only ledger of Ed25519-signed
  observation envelopes, January-June 2026, Bitcoin-anchored. Observation on
  it paused 2026-06-01; its silence figures do not accrue after that date.
- Countersign: independent witnessing of TACET epoch heads (level-3 proofs;
  planned).

## Figures

Figures are never quoted in this file. Read them, with their definitions and
last-observation dates, from:

- https://croviatrust.com/registry/data/tacet/latest.json (TACET: epochs, anchored epochs, snapshots, negative snapshots, latest sheet)
- https://croviatrust.com/registry/data/tacet/targets.json (per model: last verdict, negative and anchored-negative epochs)
- https://croviatrust.com/registry/data/tacet/trust_root.json (operator, observer, issuer keys; genesis; drand chain)
- https://croviatrust.com/registry/data/tacet/proofs/index.json (featured silence proofs, crovia.seal.v1)
- https://croviatrust.com/registry/data/model_records.json (one record per observed model: live TACET summary and/or 2026-archive observation-bounded silence; human page at https://croviatrust.com/m/<org>/<model>/)
- https://croviatrust.com/registry/data/_home_pulse.json (2026 archive: signed observations, anchors.distinct_roots, top silent model with observed_to)
- https://croviatrust.com/registry/data/silence_index.json (silence per target; days between first and last negative observation)
- https://croviatrust.com/registry/data/substrate/ots_anchors.json (Bitcoin anchors; distinct roots)
- https://croviatrust.com/registry/data/substrate/latest_seal.json (current ledger root and leaf count)

A silence figure without an observed_to date is not a Crovia figure.

## Machine endpoints

- MCP (Streamable HTTP): https://croviatrust.com/mcp — listed in the official MCP Registry as com.croviatrust/crovia; tools: crovia_status, lookup_model, search_models, get_silence_proof, verify_seal, silence_report, explain, crovia_vs_causari; resources: llms.txt, canon.json, tacet/latest.json, report.json. No auth.
- Seal verifier (web): https://croviatrust.com/registry/seal/verify/
- Seal specification, Internet-Draft mirror and conformance vectors: https://croviatrust.com/registry/seal/spec/ (SPEC.md at /registry/seal/spec/SPEC.md, vectors manifest at /registry/seal/spec/vectors/v1/manifest.json)
- TACET specification (core + PNX profile), Internet-Draft draft-crovia-tacet-00 mirror and 47 conformance tests: https://croviatrust.com/registry/tacet/spec/ (SPEC.md at /registry/tacet/spec/SPEC.md, PNX.md at /registry/tacet/spec/PNX.md, draft at /registry/tacet/spec/draft-crovia-tacet-00.txt, vectors manifest at /registry/tacet/spec/vectors/v1/manifest.json)
- Seal issuer trust root: https://seal.croviatrust.com/trust-root.json
- Seal public log: https://croviatrust.com/registry/data/seal/public_log.jsonl
- Collectors status: https://croviatrust.com/registry/data/substrate/collectors.json
- OpenAPI: https://croviatrust.com/.well-known/openapi.yaml

## Wording

Use: "the published predicate found no training-data disclosure on the
monitored surfaces in the anchored epochs between A and B (observed_to: B)". Do not assert intent ("hid", "refused", "violated"). "Crovia Seal" refers
only to crovia.seal.v1 objects. "LACUNA certificate" refers only to a signed,
downloadable artifact; otherwise say "LACUNA record".
